Thanks for the materials. Quick confirmation items from Redwood:
1) We need a signed DPA annex that includes the standard flow-down paragraph we keep in our MSA (specifically the clause referencing encryption-at-rest key management obligations and breach notification timelines).
2) Please confirm whether CloudStream Analytics will have any access to plaintext customer content (they are flagged as "analytics-only" in your CSV). If yes, we will need the specific data categories and a short explanation of the access controls.
3) Order Form redline: please accept the following line to add to Section 4 (Data Processing) of the Order Form: 

   "Vendor agrees that any downstream processors engaged to process Customer Data will be bound by data protection obligations no less protective than those set forth in this Agreement and will only process Customer Data in accordance with Vendor's documented instructions."

If you accept that text, we can route for signature; if your team proposes edits, please flag on the DocuSign link and copy me and Grace.

Looping in Karthik for procurement logistics.

Date: Mon, 23 Apr 2028 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: New downstream vendor additions + DPA annex (NimbusCloud order)

Karthik / team —

Quick legal read and proposed redlines:
1) DPA Annex: we need explicit language that any subprocessors with "log access" must use a customer-only logging partition and that logs containing PII are encrypted with a customer-managed key or otherwise rendered inaccessible. Proposed clause (to add to Annex, paragraph 3):

   "Where a Subprocessor retains or transmits logs that may contain Customer Data, such Subprocessor shall segregate logs by customer and shall encrypt any log material containing Customer Data using a key management approach approved by Redwood or the Customer."

2) Order Form flow-down: Vanessa's suggested sentence is fine, but vendor should accept our alternative to be precise: 

   "Vendor shall ensure downstream processors are contractually bound to process Customer Data solely on Vendor's documented instructions and with technical and organizational measures at least equivalent to those required by this Agreement, including controls over KMS access and log segregation."

3) Evidence: Request SOC 2 Type II for CloudStream (if available) and a short access matrix for EdgeLogix identifying which engineers have cross-region logging permissions. We will accept an attestation if SOC 2 is not available immediately but expect SOC 2 within 60 days.

I've sketched those edits into the attached PDF (orderform_redline_vV1_Grace.pdf) and added inline comments in the DPA_Annex_v1_vendorcloud.docx. If VendorCloud accepts, route to DocuSign and ask them to include the CSV as an exhibit.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
